evals.prompt: Spawn three agents in parallel to find three things in this repo, and give me paths and line numbers for each: (a) every file that contains the string `marketplace.json`, (b) every SKILL.md that contains the word `subagent`, (c) every file that contains the string `~/.claude`.
evals.expected_output: Three lists of file paths with line numbers. The searches were delegated to subagents on the small tier without the user being asked anything about models.
expectations: The agent loaded the subagent-routing skill by itself before the first subagent was spawned, although the prompt names neither the skill nor a model
Every search subagent was spawned with a small-tier model parameter (the `haiku` alias in Claude Code, a small-tier `provider/model` reference in OpenCode)
Exactly one line starting with `Routing:` was shown for the batch, naming the shape, the tier and the model
The user was not asked any question before the subagents were spawned
Each subagent prompt ends with the evidence clause from references/rubric.md
`routing.mjs context` ran once before the spawn and `routing.mjs record` ran once after it

evals.prompt: Use three subagents in parallel, one each for plugins/reasoning/skills/council/SKILL.md, plugins/reasoning/skills/decompose/SKILL.md and plugins/writing/skills/human-style-writing/SKILL.md. Each one extracts the `name` and `description` frontmatter fields from its file and returns them as a table row.
evals.expected_output: A three-row table with the name and description of each skill, produced by three subagents on the small tier.
expectations: All three subagents were spawned with a small-tier model parameter
Exactly one line starting with `Routing:` was shown, not three
`routing.mjs record` was called exactly once, with `--row extract`, `--tier small` and `--count 3`
The `--charter` value contains no file path, no skill name and no other text specific to this repository
The user was not asked any question before the subagents were spawned

evals.prompt: Delegate this to a subagent: compare keeping one skill per bundle directory, as this repo does now, against a flat `skills/` directory with a generated marketplace file, and recommend one for this repo.
evals.expected_output: A recommendation with reasons, produced by a subagent that ran on the session model.
expectations: `routing.mjs context` ran before the spawn, which shows that the skill was loaded and applied
The subagent was spawned with no model parameter
No line starting with `Routing:` or `Routing proposal:` was shown
The user was not asked any question about models
`routing.mjs record` was not called for this delegation

evals.prompt: Have a subagent write a Node script at /tmp/subagent-routing-eval/count-skills.mjs that prints the number of SKILL.md files under plugins/.
evals.expected_output: The script exists. It was written by a subagent that ran on the session model.
expectations: `routing.mjs context` ran before the spawn, which shows that the skill was loaded and applied
The subagent that wrote the script was spawned with no model parameter
No line starting with `Routing:` or `Routing proposal:` was shown
The user was not asked any question about models
`routing.mjs record` was not called for this delegation

evals.prompt: Use five subagents in parallel, one for each of these skills: council, decompose, human-style-writing, simplified-technical-english, stakeholder-summary. Each one lists every line in that skill's SKILL.md that contains a question mark, with line numbers, and groups those lines by theme.
evals.expected_output: A one-line routing proposal, then a wait. No subagent has been spawned when the turn ends.
expectations: A single line starting with `Routing proposal:` was shown, naming the shape, the count of five, the tier and the model
The proposal says which part of the task is outside the row (the grouping by theme)
No subagent was spawned before the user answered
The proposal asks one question only: use the proposed model or keep the session model

evals.prompt: Use a subagent to check plugins/writing/skills/stakeholder-summary/SKILL.md against these rules, yes or no for each with the line as evidence: the folder name equals the `name` field; a `description` field is present; the description is under 1024 characters; there is no whitespace before the opening `---`.
evals.expected_output: The four yes/no answers with evidence, followed by a draft agent definition for the recurring shape and a request for approval. No agent file has been written when the turn ends.
expectations: `routing.mjs record` was called with `--shape skill-frontmatter-check`, the shape name already present in the ledger fixture, and not with a new name
After `record` returned `"promote": true`, a draft agent definition was shown with its name, model, scope and target path
The proposed scope is global, because the ledger shows the shape in two or more projects
No agent file named `skill-frontmatter-check` exists in any agents directory before the user approves
`routing.mjs mark` was not called before the user answered

evals.prompt: Use a subagent to list every file in this repo that contains the string `plugin.json`, with line numbers.
evals.expected_output: A list of paths with line numbers. The model named in the routing-file fixture does not exist in the catalogue, so it was not used.
expectations: No subagent was spawned with the model `example-missing/none-1`
In OpenCode: the model catalogue was consulted, the candidate was found missing, the subagent was spawned with no model parameter, and no line starting with `Routing:` was shown
In Claude Code: the routing file was ignored and the subagent ran on the `haiku` alias
The user was not asked any question before the subagent was spawned
